svg.title: Goodjohn: Bread80 CPC464 SMT J1 two-ribbon wiring to Pico
svg.desc: Keyboard J1 configured for CPC464. Ribbon A uses odd PCB pads; B uses even pads. Bridge LK1 pads 1-2 and LK2; leave LK3 open. Nineteen wires preserve X8 and X9 separately. A10, J1 pad 19, is unused. B10, J1 pad 20, connects Y1. USB supplies power and data. Source-checked wiring guide, not bench-tested or a PCB layout.
svg.text: Two 10-pin ribbons to Raspberry Pi Pico
Bread80 CPC464 SMT keyboard J1 / CPC464 link setting / 19 matrix signals
KEYBOARD LINKS: LK1 bridge pads 1-2 only; LK2 bridge pads 1-2; LK3 OPEN.
Leave LK4-LK6 open. Disconnect CPC motherboard. Unplug USB before changing wires or links.
Wiring guide: ribbons drawn separately; see orientation inset below

svg.text: A/B are labels for this guide. Follow pad numbers.
Nineteen signal wires only. No keyboard power or ground wire. Crossings are not electrical junctions.
Source-checked; not bench-tested. Target: Bread80 CPC464 SMT J1, CPC464 setting. Details: docs/wiring-dual-ribbon.md
Pico vector artwork adapted from supplied pico-pinout.svg. Not a PCB layout. Other connector versions need separate mapping.
